description: Department of Inland Revenue - Notice  specify the circumstances under which a tax payer may designate an authorized representative
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under Section 115 of the Inland Revenue Act, No. 24 of 2017, specifying the circumstances under which taxpayers may designate authorized representatives to communicate with the Inland Revenue Department. It establishes regulatory procedures and compliance requirements for tax administration, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the Commissioner General is incidental to the regulatory function being established.
